data.Q: Why does the young man tell the commander not to go along with the Jews?
data.A: Because more than forty of them are waiting in ambush to kill Paul.
data.wrong_answer: Because they want more accurate information about Paul.

data.Q: Whose consent are the ambushers waiting for now?
After hearing the report, what does the commander do with the young man?
data.A: He dismisses him and warns him not to tell anyone.
data.wrong_answer: He takes him aside and asks for his message.

data.Q: Who does the commander warn not to tell anyone?
What reason do the Jews give for asking to bring Paul?
data.A: To get more accurate information about Paul.

data.Q: To whom has the young man given his report?
